page.layout: One printed page, single column of centred display type, with a decorative ornament band at the top; a signature mark and catchword at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.head: VERA ET ANTIQVA NOBILITATE, AC STRENVITATE, VIRTVTVM HEROICARVM, INGENVARVMque literarum ornamentis splendidissimis & excultissimis VIRIS,

p.i: Dn. Otthoni Gvlielmo à Berlepsch, Archiprefecto Comitatus Cattimelibocensis Inferioris, &c.
Dn. Hermanno à Malsburg, &c. Illvstrissimi Hassiæ Principis ac Dn. Dn. Mauritii, &c. Consiliariis intimis: Dominis suis plurimum obseruandis,

main_text.p: Rodolphus Goclenius D. precatur felicitatem summam.

page.notes: Display type set in large capitals and small capitals; the ornament band at the top is decorative and not transcribed. Some letters in the name lines are doubtful due to the scan (e.g. "Berleps", "Malsburg", "Hermanno"); the printed forms are "Berleps" and "Malsburg" as shown. Heavy show-through and marbled endpaper edges at the margins are not transcribed.
